boundaries: Official usage is deduplicated by response_id within the exact thread; cumulative token_usage notifications are not summed.

Per-response input tokens describe provider accounting of the whole request, not just RPent task text. Cached input is a subset of input; reasoning tokens are a reported output detail, not an extra additive bucket.
Base instructions metadata, initial developer blocks and user message metadata are visible; no raw prompt, arguments, image URL, account or email is exported.

Transcript counters before a usage record describe append order only. They do not prove that every preceding item/image was sent in that exact request, and do not map tokenizer tokens to individual components.
Tool discovery catalogs contain name/description entries; these are not complete outbound tool schemas. Actual tool definition count/serialized length remain null.
Provider image encoding, framing, system/tool serialization, tokenization, cache selection and context compaction prevent exact reconstruction from these local records.
HTTP and WebSocket attempts, logical sampling calls, usage completions, errors and warmup are distinct counts. Completion log events are not a request counter.
Transport span unions are client-observed wall time including transport and handling, not pure model prefill/thinking/decode.

episode_clock_contract.formula: outside_sdk_s := transcript.elapsed_s - transcript.stats.elapsed_s; T_episode = SDK_elapsed + outside_sdk by definition

episode_start.boundary: after robot_spec.init_runtime at506; before agent-loop/toolkit construction

episode_end.boundary: after toolkit.close635 and daemons.stop665–666; before transcript writing679 and finalize_run691

sdk_start.boundary: after in-thread MCP server start159–160; before SDK worker creation/start

sdk_end.boundary: after worker join/cancellation path and MCP server stop221

limitations: outside_sdk is a residual, not an independently timed stage.
Two independently rounded one-decimal durations limit residual precision; wall clocks are not monotonic.
T_episode excludes runtime/daemon startup before t0 and excludes later transcript/finalization writes; it is not full process wall time.
SDK elapsed includes local worker setup/teardown, tool execution, transport and MCP stop; it is not cloud-only model inference.
The equality is arithmetic bookkeeping, not independent validation of causal stage attribution.
